body: It might be better to create a new material and shader type for this, so that users can have full control over the rendering, rather than just having a base texture and perspective transformation. However, this needs much more works.
The code is a bit messy and has bugs, but I did a proof of concept for using ShaderMaterial on RasterizedMeshTexture to do custom drawing. This functionality is somewhat similar to #105701.

Now it works, ~the only problem is that it doesn't automatically update when shader parameters changed.~ (I worked around it by adding `DEPENDENCY_CHANGED_MATERIAL_PARAM`) Test project: [rasterized-mesh-tex (1).zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20237416/rasterized-mesh-tex.1.zip) Note vertices that are not within the visible range will be clipped. x: [-1, 1], y: [-1, 1], z: [0, 1]

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2e930bec-85b4-4e45-a55d-b7b405d17503

>but when I add a shader, the texture stops showing up.

It's because the projection is actually zero matrix until modifying or reloading the scene. I opened a separate issue #106561
You can also modify the ww component to globally scale.

> You can also modify the ww component to globally scale.

I did not realized that but that makes total sense.

Pushed a simplified implementation (just a single `texture_drawable_draw_mesh` to draw, no separate `mesh_rasterizer` rid), and it completely avoids processing mesh on CPU. However, this means the mesh matrix needs to be manually adjusted otherwise the default position may be not good.

Removed MSAA settings.

[rasterized-mesh-tex](https://github.com/beicause/rasterized-mesh-tex-test)

> I just want to point out it and hope to discuss and collaborate. If you think https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/106331 worthless, I would cease further efforts on this.

We're in the middle of trying to release Godot Engine 4.5. The Godot Engine maintainers are working hard on closing release blockers. Since this is a feature enhancement, it will have lower priority.

Sometimes after a release work gets forgotten, but I'll try to expedite review in the Godot Engine 4.6 cycle.

Hope that helps!
Compatibility renderer works now, part of the code is referenced from https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/105701

Update: partially fixed.

Partially(mostly) fixed VVL errors. The remaining error (VUID-vkCmdDrawIndexed-None-08600) might be related to #109566.

<details>
<summary>Detailed explanation</summary>

1. Immediately freeing the texture slice after drawing was problematic. Fixed by caching all layers and mipmap slices in the texture.
2. `CopyEffect::make_mipmap` only worked for rgba16f images in Forward+. Fixed by using `CopyEffect::make_mipmaps_raster` in Forward+ as well as Mobile.
</details>
Why was this closed? It's the only one that supports DrawableTextureArrays. The other PR is incomplete without that.

I need to reconsider if this is worth maintaining compared to viewport and RenderingDevice.

The simplest way to implement drawable textures is making a wrapper of the RenderingServer viewport api, which is also used to generate thumbnails. Its performance  may be good enough.

Also, we will have `texture_update_partial` hopefully soon (#109985), which can be used for partially updating Texture2DArray and Texture3D from CPU data.
